findings: Config binds paranoid shadow to RM_DIGEST_XXHASH, resolving prior uncertainty about xxhash-specific extraction in checksum.c. Default ordinary digest is BLAKE2B.

Observed release_buffers call occurs in RM_SHRED_GROUP_FINISHING before result processing. That is consistent with releasing byte evidence after grouping; it does not alone prove hash-only admission during initial grouping.
Sift discards files marked hashing_failed before hashtable lookup, then uses rm_digest_hash plus rm_digest_equal for child-group membership.

New child-group digest is sent as candidate to in-progress digests under parent lock. Paranoid task setup creates a fresh paranoid digest, registers pending digest and sends existing child candidates under same lock.
Non-paranoid task path copies progressive group digest; inspected code therefore narrows prior copy concern for the main paranoid hashing path.
Lifecycle of child groups, final status transition, mutation checks and output processing still require full reading before claiming strict correctness or a reachable lifecycle defect.
limits: Only config header receives whole-file credit; shredder.c partial.
No runtime tests or implementation edits. Native pHash deferred; global count150/500.
